description: Require match eligibility, outcome, mode, participant and bracket definitions before comparing win observations.

guide.applicability: Use for a bounded mode, version and participant scope with reviewed competitive semantics.
guide.context_boundary: Returned win rate does not establish balance, matchmaking fairness or player skill without further methods and coverage.
steps: Resolve eligible match, outcome, mode, participant, bracket and version semantics.
Query the governed event metric for explicit returned groups and preserve completeness and sample limits.
Report observed outcome differences and exclusions without balance, fairness or causal claims.
guide.title: Competitive outcome observation

summary: Review returned competitive outcomes under explicit match and participant semantics.
